scope: Phase 3.5 — In-app notifications feed (event-bus fan-out) + AI Copilot action-taking (confirm-before-execute)
tested_by: testing_agent (backend pytest, timed out before frontend) + main agent (fix verification via curl + playwright UI flows)

failures_and_fixes.cause: Vertex AI per-minute quota saturation (429 -> 503) from rapid sequential test calls. Transient, not a code bug.
failures_and_fixes.fix: None needed; verified passing with single call after quota window.

failures_and_fixes.cause: Action context listed only 25 of 91 distributors, so the copilot (correctly) refused unknown destination 'A-D-BASHARU JIMETA'.
failures_and_fixes.fix: copilot_actions.build_action_context limits raised: distributors 25->150, wholesalers 10->30, products 30->60. Verified: same distributor now resolves to exact id and proposes dispatch_adhoc.

failures_and_fixes.cause: 45-min notification dedupe wrongly applied to user-triggered milestone events (route_replanned), suppressing the second reroute notification.
failures_and_fixes.fix: logistics_events._fanout_notifications now dedupes ONLY warning/critical alert types; info milestones (route_planned/replanned/completed, delivery_completed) always notify. Verified: notification count 30->31 with 'Truck TK-021 re-routed by Copilot' on top.

verified_flows: copilot chat returns {reply, action:{proposed}} for action intents; action:null for pure questions

execute endpoint: reroute_vehicle (deviation cleared, google route, route_progress 0, fresh ETA), resolve_exception (stopped->in_transit), dispatch_adhoc (RT-008 created, truck dispatched), acknowledge_events (68 events acked)
execute is idempotent; dismissed actions return 400 on execute; failed actions retryable
history endpoint joins action objects with live status

notification fan-out: manufacturer feed (warning/critical + milestones), warehouse feed ('Route RT-xxx dispatched from your warehouse'), destination distributor feed ('Inbound shipment ... on the way')

frontend.method: playwright via screenshot_tool (testing agent timed out before frontend phase)
verified_flows: NotificationsPopover: type icons + severity-colored chips, All/Unread tabs, unread badge, live entries ('Truck TK-040 re-routed by Copilot', 'Route RT-008 planned')
CopilotPanel: action request -> action card with 'awaiting confirmation' badge + Execute/Dismiss buttons -> Execute -> 'executed' badge + green result message
Persistence: page reload re-renders action cards from history with final statuses
Grounded refusal: 'Clear the stop on TK-012' correctly declined (no stop exception) without proposing an action
Plain questions still answer normally with no action card

notes: Vertex AI quota is per-minute; bursts of >6 copilot calls/min may 503 briefly (handled gracefully in UI via toast + retry guidance).
